taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Kenpoly-convocation-arena (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1434 | 2.5 | 2.5
2 | 1879 | 5.42 | 7.92
3 | 318 | 18 | 25.9
4 | 3488 | 24.3 | 50.2
5 | 542 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Kenpoly-convocation-arena (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: KHK
Aquifer depth: 7.92 m – 25.9 m
Recommendation: Target the low-resistivity (318 ohm-m) sand/aquiferous zone between 7.92 m and 25.9 m for the main water strike, but screen and case carefully as this unit may contain clayey/silty intercalations; the underlying high-resistivity layer (25.9–50.2 m) should be treated as a confining/aquitard unit, and drilling can proceed deeper to test the terminal layer (>50.2 m, 542 ohm-m) as a possible secondary aquifer if additional yield is required.
